name: nodejs-express-api
description: A layered Express API: MVC + service + repository, clustering, Redis cache, Docker.

scripts.//start: Production entry: the cluster primary forks one worker per CPU.
scripts.//dev: Dev entry: a SINGLE process (easier to debug; no fork noise) with watch-reload.
scripts.//test:smoke: Hit the running server's health + a route to sanity-check.
